evidence.reason: The implementation substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the extracted instance name, but systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance and `%I` as the unescaped instance. Thus for `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` resolves to `crq-tick.service`, while this code produces `crq\x2dtick.service` and misses the dependency. This is an ordinary correctness defect; `%I` must use systemd unit-name unescaping while `%i` remains unchanged.
